notes: Customer: enterprise fintech — low tolerance for tail latency, must support EU data residency for EMEA ops
Primary workload: trader-assistant chat + reranking for fraud signals during market open spikes
Performance targets: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 120ms for 4-token steady prompts; peak concurrency target ~120 concurrent sessions per region
Throughput expectation: sustained 10k tokens/sec across cluster during peak; need guarantee on reserved capacity throughput and predictable scaling
Reserved GPU ask: baseline reserved pool to cover 75% of normal traffic + burst capacity for 2x spikes; interested in warm-pool strategy to avoid cold starts
Autoscaling policy discussed: scale-up on CPU/GPU queue depth + request latency signal; target ramp: add 1 node per 30s until target; scale-down cooldown 10m after sustained low utilization
Warm pool details: prefer 2 hot nodes pre-warmed per region during market hours; warm image + warmed KV caches to reduce first-token latency — Redwood to propose warm-pool pricing
Queueing & backpressure: want multi-lane queue — priority lane (trader UI) + best-effort lane (analytics), if priority queue >5s then fallback to smaller quantized model with lower cost
Fallback routing: automatic downgrade to quantized model variant (q4/q8) when warm pool exhausted; must maintain deterministic degrade behavior documented

SLA asks: 99.95% uptime, credits tied to p95 latency breaches during market hours; legal wants explicit 'throughput guarantee' clause — i.e., X tokens/sec per reserved GPU and a definition for 'capacity saturation'
Cost sensitivity: willing to pay premium for dedicated reserved capacity with strong SLOs but needs predictable monthly commit; exploring 12mo vs 36mo pricing, wants clear early-termination terms
Security: must support customer-managed KMS, detailed audit logs with 180-day retention, SAML SSO for console access, and private control plane (VPC peering); on-prem option for high-risk workloads
Perf notes from bench: A100-like node delivered ~140 tokens/sec for gen-heavy prompts in our test harness; observed cold-start + KV priming cost ~300-500ms — warm pool reduces this to ~20-50ms

Initial recommended sizing: baseline 8 GPUs per primary region to cover 75% normal, with 4 GPU warm pool and 8 GPU burst buffer (policy-controlled). Numbers tentative — needs POC run against real traffic
POC plan: 2-week dedicated POC during market open hours, Redwood to instrument token-level cost/latency traces & provide dashboard; Apogee to provide canonical prompt set and traffic replay
Open items: define 'throughput unit' in contract, acceptance criteria for POC, finalizing scale-up/scale-down thresholds, confirm warm pool billing model
